title: Higher covering spaces in an $\infty$-topos
summary: We develop a systematic theory of $(n-1)$-truncated maps, called $n$-covering maps, in a fixed $\infty$-topos $\mathscr{E}$, guided by the analogy with classical covering spaces. We prove an equivalence of $n$-categories between $n$-coverings over a pointed connected object $(X,x)$ and $\infty$-actions of the fundamental $n$-group $Π_n(X,x)$ on $(n-1)$-truncated objects, which restricts to a classification of pointed connected $n$-coverings in terms of sub-$n$-groups of $Π_n(X,x)$.
